newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht eases, interbank rate down sharply.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht eases, interbank rate down sharply.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate fell sharply to 11.00 percent near the market close from 13.50- 14.00 in the morning and 14.00-14.50 late on Thursday.
Dealers said most banks were left with more surplus funds on Friday afternoon after they had met cash reserve requirements set by the central bank.
They said, however, that any further decline of interbank rates next week would be limited by continued draining of funds by currency traders speculating on the baht.
The baht moved in a narrow range of 25.610/25.620 to the dollar during late trading against 25.610/25.615 in the morning and 25.595/25.598 late on Thursday, dealers said.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the dollar/baht mid-rate at 25.58 against 25.55 on Thursday.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium rose sharply to 10.25/10.75 satangs per dollar from 9.50/10.00 in the morning and 11.00/11.80 late on Thursday.
